+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboPaint controller for the Irises reference task.
+
+The optional --probe mode paints color/width samples on the unscored practice
+sheet.  The default mode paints the target on the scored main sheet.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/runs")
+SHEET_Z = 0.020
+PAINT_Z = 0.028
+UP_Z = 0.060
+CONTACT_Z = 0.0185
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def pose(x, y, z):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray([x, y, z], dtype=np.float32), Q_DOWN]
+
+
+def main_world(u_mm, v_mm, spec):
+    """Pixel-style sheet coordinates: u right, v down from the far edge."""
+    sh = spec["static"]["sheets"]["main"]
+    sx, sy = sh["size_m"]
+    cx, cy = sh["center_xy"]
+    return cx + sx / 2 - v_mm / 1000.0, cy + sy / 2 - u_mm / 1000.0
+
+
+def practice_world(u_mm, v_mm, spec):
+    sh = spec["static"]["sheets"]["practice"]
+    sx, sy = sh["size_m"]
+    cx, cy = sh["center_xy"]
+    return cx + sx / 2 - v_mm / 1000.0, cy + sy / 2 - u_mm / 1000.0
+
+
+def submit_path(robot, rows, *, cameras=("canvas_cam", "side_cam"), note=""):
+    rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+    if not len(rows):
+        return None
+    # Each chunk represents at most 10 nominal seconds.  Keep ample room for
+    # IK's velocity limiting and preserve the exact path between chunks.
+    last = None
+    for i in range(0, len(rows), 180):
+        last = robot.submit(
+            "ee_pose", rows[i:i + 180], dt=0.05,
+            cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note,
+        )
+        plan = last.meta.get("plan")
+        if plan:
+            print(json.dumps({"note": note, "plan": plan}, default=str), flush=True)
+        if last.meta.get("done"):
+            break
+    return last
+
+
+def probe(robot, spec):
+    """Lay 16 measured short lines, one from each palette well, on practice."""
+    wells = spec["static"]["wells"]["wells"]
+    rows = []
+    # evenly spaced color strips over the long (far-to-near) practice axis
+    for i, well in enumerate(wells):
+        wx, wy = well["center_xy"]
+        rows.extend([pose(wx, wy, UP_Z), pose(wx, wy, PAINT_Z - 0.001)] * 2)
+        rows.append(pose(wx, wy, UP_Z))
+        v = 10.0 + i * 13.7
+        x0, y0 = practice_world(35.0, v, spec)
+        x1, y1 = practice_world(64.0, v, spec)
+        rows.extend([
+            pose(x0, y0, UP_Z), pose(x0, y0, CONTACT_Z),
+            pose(x0, y0, CONTACT_Z),
+        ])
+        # 29 mm line at about 4.8 cm/s, slow enough to deposit a solid mark.
+        for a in np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 31)[1:]:
+            rows.append(pose(x0 * (1 - a) + x1 * a,
+                             y0 * (1 - a) + y1 * a, CONTACT_Z))
+        rows.append(pose(x1, y1, UP_Z))
+    res = submit_path(robot, rows, cameras=("practice_cam", "side_cam"), note="practice palette swatches")
+    if res:
+        out = OUT / "probe"
+        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for cam, img in res.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(img).save(out / f"{cam}.png")
+        (out / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2, default=str))
+        print(f"Saved practice camera views to {out}", flush=True)
+
+
+def paint(robot, spec):
+    raise NotImplementedError("main-sheet path generation is filled after practice calibration")
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--probe", action="store_true", help="paint practice swatches and stop")
+    ap.add_argument("--main", action="store_true", help="paint the main sheet")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+    print("connected; status:", json.dumps(robot.status()), flush=True)
+    if args.probe:
+        probe(robot, spec)
+    if args.main:
+        paint(robot, spec)
+    if not args.probe and not args.main:
+        probe(robot, spec)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
